pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Pure Perl bridge package — no Rust compilation. Generates thin Proxmox::RS::* stub modules via perlmod-bin's genpackage.pl using --lib=- (delegating to whichever Rust library is already loaded: Proxmox::Lib::PVE from libpve-rs-perl, or Proxmox::Lib::PMG).
Installs: Proxmox::Lib::Common — delegates .so loading to PVE or PMG loader Proxmox::Lib::SslProbe — pure Perl openssl cert path probe PVE::RS::CalendarEvent — compat alias (deprecated) Proxmox::RS::APT::Repositories Proxmox::RS::CalendarEvent Proxmox::RS::Notify Proxmox::RS::OIDC Proxmox::RS::SharedCache Proxmox::RS::Subscription
Required by: libpve-access-control, libpve-common-perl (runtime)
